drafts-xh-r2-01-001.text: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, amanzi okunkcenkceshela iidiliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.
drafts-xh-r2-01-001.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.

drafts-xh-r2-01-002.text: Ngu-6 ngentsasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.
drafts-xh-r2-01-002.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.

drafts-xh-r2-01-003.text: Izilwanyana zasendle azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azikhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
drafts-xh-r2-01-003.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.

drafts-xh-r2-01-004.text: Isiselo sokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba sihlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.
drafts-xh-r2-01-004.en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.

drafts-xh-r2-01-005.text: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje abakuboni nakancinci.
drafts-xh-r2-01-005.en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
